## Accommodation

Amangwane offers self-catering, en-suite tented accommodation. All units have private reed bathrooms with hot shower, basin and toilet. Linen and bath towels are included. Each unit has a private wooden deck.

Unit types:
- 2-Sleeper Unit: Two single beds, private en-suite, private deck
- 3-Sleeper Unit: Three single beds, private en-suite, private deck
- Family Bunk Unit: Bunk beds (sleeps up to 4), private en-suite, private deck

Check-in: 14:00 | Check-out: 10:00
Payment: Cash or EFT
Currency: South African Rand (ZAR)
Self-catering: Yes (guests bring own food and supplies)

## Activities at Kosi Bay Mouth

All activities are booked at camp reception on arrival. No pre-booking required except turtle tours.

1. Snorkelling — The Aquarium: Self-guided. Sheltered rock pool with tropical fish and coral. Accessible from the beach. Free.
2. 3-Lake Boat Cruise: Guided cruise through the Kosi Bay lake system. Hippos, crocodiles and birdlife.
3. Turtle Tracking Tours: Guided night tours. Loggerhead and leatherback sea turtles. Season: mid-November to mid-March. Departs 16:30. R950 per person. Min 3 guests. Must book in advance.
4. Kayak Safari: Guided paddle through the Kosi Bay estuary and mangroves.
5. Thonga Fish Kraal Tours: Cultural tour of the ancient traditional fish traps in the estuary.
6. Fishing (Lakes and Beach): Shore and boat fishing. Species: kob, shad, grunter, rock cod.
7. Birding: 300+ species in iSimangaliso. African Fish Eagle, Pel's Fishing Owl, flamingos, kingfishers.
8. Guided Beach Hikes: Guided walks along the Kosi Bay beach and coastal forest.
9. Beach Time: Unspoilt, uncrowded beach 2km from camp.
10. Cultural Experience: Kosi Mouth community and cultural visits.
11. Mozambique Day Trip: Day trip to Mozambique across the Kosi Bay border.
12. Tembe Elephant Park: Day trip to Tembe Elephant Park, home to the largest free-roaming elephants in the world.
13. Bhanga Nek & Black Rock: Day trip to snorkelling and beach destination north of Kosi Bay.
14. 4x4 Beach Transfer: Transfer to Kosi Bay Mouth beach by 4x4 vehicle.

## Location & Access

Kosi Bay Mouth is in the far north of KwaZulu-Natal, near the Mozambique border. The access road requires a 4x4 or high-clearance vehicle. The nearest town is Manguzi (also known as Kwangwanase). Kosi Bay is approximately 100km north of Hluhluwe and 400km north of Durban.

## About iSimangaliso Wetland Park

iSimangaliso Wetland Park is a UNESCO World Heritage Site protecting a unique ecosystem of lakes, wetlands, beaches, coral reefs and coastal forests. It is home to hippos, crocodiles, loggerhead and leatherback turtles, hundreds of bird species, and diverse marine life. The Kosi Bay lake system is the northernmost part of the park.
